name: @contractor/native-attachment
description: Attachment staging and resume (M03-T06): durable staging/finalization protocol with digest compute+verify at both boundaries, chunked server registration resuming from the server's authoritative offset, append-only sanitized reconciliation journal, typed recoverable failures preserving pending data, orphan sweep, resume after app launch/foregrounding/manual sync. Evidence runs against real local storage (on-disk object store) + real SQLite (node:sqlite) + a disposable server/object fixture.
